description: This Java class 'CredentialsClientFactoryImpl' implements a factory for creating and managing 'CredentialsClient' instances for the Hono API, handling connection management, caching, and tenant timeout events.

classes.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing CredentialsClient instances, handling connection lifecycle, caching, and tenant timeout events.

methods.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and optional cache provider.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup when disconnecting by clearing client cache state.

methods.name: getOrCreateCredentialsClient
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to a CredentialsClient for a given tenant ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: removeCredentialsClient
methods.description: Removes a CredentialsClient associated with a tenant ID.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing the associated CredentialsClient.
